rule: validly granted author/work/part/asset/comic-page/comic-panel rights cannot be arbitrarily revoked
adminRightsRule: Only explicitly delegated rights granted by Master Admin are executable by an Admin; absence of a grant means deny.

captureProtection.android: OS-level secure-window capture blocking where supported
captureProtection.ios: OS-level capture protection where supported by native implementation
captureProtection.web: best-effort content protection; no false guarantee of absolute screenshot prevention
captureProtection.nativeImplementationRequirement: Android FLAG_SECURE / equivalent and iOS capture-protection APIs where supported; device capability must be surfaced, never falsely reported as universal.

unauthorizedClickAudit: Every unauthorized Admin dashboard/action click returns not_authorized and creates an auditable event.
